test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper purchased an article for Rs. 3,000. What will be the percentage of profit (approximately) if he sells that article for Rs. 3,600?
solution:
GIVEN:

Cost Price = 3000

Selling Price = 3600

FORMULA USED:

Profit percentage = (Selling price - Cost price) / Cost price × 100

SOLUTION:

Cost Price = 3000

Selling Price = 3600

Profit percentage = (Selling price - Cost price) / Cost price × 100

Profit percentage = (3600 - 3000) / 3000 × 100

Profit percentage = 600 / 3000 × 100

Profit percentage = 0.2 × 100

Profit percentage = 20

Hence option 3 is the valid answer.
